resume_text:
MAYA OKONKWO
Backend Engineer | Lisbon, Portugal
maya.okonkwo@example.com | github.com/mayaok

EXPERIENCE

Junior Backend Engineer, Verdant Logistics
March 2023 - Present | Lisbon (hybrid)
- Built and maintained REST endpoints in FastAPI for the shipment tracking service.
- Migrated 14 legacy Flask endpoints to FastAPI without downtime.
- Wrote the PostgreSQL queries behind the carrier reconciliation report.
- Added pytest coverage for the pricing module, taking it from 31% to 78%.

Backend Intern, Verdant Logistics
July 2022 - February 2023 | Lisbon
- Fixed defects in the internal admin tooling.
- Automated a nightly data export with a scheduled Celery task.

PROJECTS

ledgerline (github.com/mayaok/ledgerline)
A double-entry bookkeeping library in Python. Uses SQLAlchemy for persistence
and Hypothesis for property-based tests.

EDUCATION

BSc Computer Science, University of Lisbon, 2019 - 2022

SKILLS

Python, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Docker, Git, pytest
